title: schematic read
observations: Read 58 schematic components (designator/component/symbol/footprint/x/y/rotation/mirror/supplierId) and 34 wires with real geometry; pins returned actual x/y, pinNumber, pinType, noConnected.
waitForDocumentReady() returned false for both the page uuid and the tab handle even though the page was activated and components were readable; it is not a usable readiness gate.

sch_Net.getAllNets(), getAllNetsName() and getCurrentProjectAllNets() all returned [] on a loaded project whose Protel netlist is 34,413 bytes, so the typed net API cannot be the source of truth; parsing the netlist text is required.
Component read required allSchematicPages=true to see the whole design; per-page reads follow the active document.
risks: net enumeration API returns empty on this fixture/version - silent data loss if trusted
background/inactive pages return shallow data; explicit page activation is required
text objects and title-block content were not probed in this run
